title: A multi-speaker dataset of real-time two-dimensional speech magnetic resonance images with articulator ground-truth segmentations (v2)
publication: Ruthven et al. 2023, Scientific Data 10:860, DOI 10.1038/s41597-023-02766-z
production_type: controlled articulatory speech production; real-time MRI; counting 1-10
manual_evidence: All 392 speech-MRI frames were manually pixel-segmented by an experienced MRI physicist into six articulatory/anatomical classes; every frame was independently visually labelled for velopharyngeal contact by four MRI physicists with majority/consensus adjudication; a 10% subset was manually re-segmented for intra-rater validation
available_primary_data: data.zip (21.9 MB; MD5 2c5fb95e6294ecf97204f64128137a96): 5 DICOM image series; 392 per-frame MAT GT masks; velopharyngeal_closure.xlsx with per-frame binary GT contact labels
notes: Accept. Five healthy adults (2F/3M; 24-28), one image series each, 0.1 s temporal resolution; series lengths 105/71/71/78/67 frames. Preserve masks as full pixel-level articulatory observations and contact labels as frame-level categorical production measures; do not collapse trajectories.
